headline: Super Spinning Mills to start SEBI‑compliant demat processing in Q2 2026
summary: Super Spinning Mills has announced it will begin SEBI‑compliant demat processing in the second quarter of 2026. The change will allow its shares to be held electronically in demat accounts, replacing physical certificates. This regulatory compliance improves liquidity and ease of trading for shareholders. Indian retail investors holding or planning to buy shares in the company will benefit from simpler transfer and settlement processes.
